facts.title: 1492: Conquest of Paradise

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When Columbus sights land, the wonder of reaching a new world quickly collides with the grave consequences awaiting the people who already live there.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Ridley Scott’s sweeping historical drama follows Christopher Columbus on his voyage across the ocean to the New World, chronicling the expedition and its profound impact on the indigenous people he encounters.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Immersive, solemn, and grandly staged, offering measured pacing and deep dramatic weight best suited for focused solo viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Scott mounts a massive, visual voyage across uncharted waters, balancing the adrenaline of ocean exploration with the weighty, complicated human fallout of early imperial contact.
